'''CSA corporate script''' was a form of [[Currency/Legends|currency]] produced by the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. It was accepted in establishments on CSA-aligned [[Planet/Legends|planets]] such as the [[StarFlight Lounge]] on [[Bonadan/Legends|Bonadan]].<ref name="CFTD">''[[Cynabar's Fantastic Technology: Droids]]''</ref>
